contentHtml:
The Emirates ID or Emirates Verification Card is an identification document. One of the first things you should know is that the Federal Identity and Citizenship Authority is the one in charge of all this. It is for both citizens and residents who are in the UAE. It is important to highlight that all the inhabitants of the country must request it. The function of this document is basically to protect the identity of the individual. Additionally, to obtain or renew the card, it is necessary to verify the Emirates ID status.

In this article, we will explain everything you need about the verification of the Emirates ID status in the UAE in the year 2023. In essence, we will show you how you can check the status of your ID application through the Internet. That is the Emirates ID status. We will also teach you what are the requirements you must meet to obtain it. Finally, you will see why it is important to have access to it. In other words, the benefits that individuals who have their identification have.

Understanding the importance of Emirates ID

Before knowing how to verify the Emirates ID, you have to know what this identification is and what its importance is. To acquire the Emirates ID, one must obtain it through the Federal Authority of Identity and Citizenship (FAIC). The card consists of a 15-digit number, that is, the unified number, an electronic chip, personal data, and your photograph.

People who reside in rural areas must hold identification on their person constantly. Generally, the Emirates ID facilitates requests and transactions, both private and governmental. Furthermore, it provides ease in the online of intelligent services.

This card has many uses within the country and therein lies its importance. Among the most important are getting a new SIM card and a new home internet package. Another of the benefits of the Emirates ID is that it allows you to perform other tasks such as paying utility bills and opening bank accounts. You can also apply for a Dubai driver’s license. That is why it is essential to be clear about your Emirates ID status.

The card includes an electronic chip that can store up to 32,000 letters of information. Most of the data is encrypted and can only be accessed by authorized entities and personnel. That is, this identification is a base of your personal data. Currently, the cards are made with polycarbonate. This means that they can last 10 years or more. Finally, the card has code definitions and additional fields.

On the other hand, the benefits of the Emirates ID are not only for online services. Since 2022 this identification has residence visa status. That is to say, the previous residence visa stamping in the residents’ passports was replaced by the identification card.

Step-by-step guide to Emirates ID verification process

Before we teach you how to check your Emirates ID status, you have to know how to get the ID card. The first thing to know is that the Emirates ID application process must be done in conjunction with the country’s visa application procedure. Therefore, below, you will see the steps for the process of obtaining a residence in the UAE.

Entry to the UAE: For this, an entry permit must be requested. Business owners who operate their business within the country are eligible for this permit. Other candidates for this permit are employees who work for companies based in the UAE. The entry permit is valid only for 60 days or 2 months.

Medical check-ups: You have to go to any Preventive Medicine Center for medical examinations. If the medical results are satisfactory, you can take the next step for the residency application.

Application for the identification card or Emirates ID: For this, you must go to any office of the Federal Authority of Identity and Citizenship (FAIC). They will request your biometric data which will be stored in the Authority’s system.

Obtaining the residence visa: Finally, you must stamp the visa that is in the passport. By having this stamp, you will have your Emirates ID and your residence.

To take advantage of investment opportunities in Dubai you must have a valid Emirates ID. That is why you must be clear about your Emirates ID status. You can control this through the internet, you just need your unified number and follow the next steps.

  • Visit the FAIC website and there look for the service “Verify Emirates ID status”. You will find it on the upper right-hand side of the page.
  • Once you are on that web page, enter the unified number and you will see the status.

Documents required for Emirates ID verification

Before knowing the documents, you need to check your Emirates ID status, it is good to know what documents you need to obtain the verification card. Next, you will see what are the papers you require for this obtaining process. It should be clarified that citizens and foreigners have different requirements.

In the case of citizens, they must have the following requirements

  • Valid and original passport.
  • Social security certificate
  • Book of your family nucleus in the UAE.
  • People with disabilities or people over 65 must provide a medical certificate.
  • Children under 15 years of age must present their birth certificate.

Foreigners need other different documents but in less quantity.

  • Original and valid residence visa.
  • Original and valid passport.
  • Foreigners under 15 years of age must present a birth certificate.

On the other hand, regarding the documents for the verification of the Emirates ID status, you should know that this will depend on the type of request you make. If it is a new application, you must present a photocopy of your passport or travel document and a photo with a white background. If the application is for a newborn child, you must provide the population registry number.

In case you want to verify the Emirates ID after performing a renewal or replacement, you just have to present your passport or old Emirates ID. In addition, to pay the corresponding Emirates ID cost and provide the biometric data.

Visiting the Emirates ID centers: locations and procedures

In order to complete the ID card or Emirates ID tracking application process, you must visit an Emirates ID Biometrics Center. These have the function of receiving and storing the biometric data of the applicants and other additional ones concerning the card. For instance, new Emirates ID issuance, card renewal, fingerprint capture, and more.

Below you will see a list of all Emirates ID biometrics centers along with their location in Dubai.

Al Baraha Customer Satisfaction Office: You can find it in Deira, Dubai. The service they offer is fingerprinting exclusively for the Emirates ID application.

Al Barsha Customer Satisfaction Center: You can find this center in District 3 of Al Barsha. Its function is to offer all services regarding the Emirates ID. That is, check the Emirates ID status, issuance, renewal, replacement, and more.

Hatta Customer Happiness Office: You will find this office in the Department of Naturalization and Residency building in Hatta. It exclusively offers a fingerprinting service for the issuance of the Emirates ID.

Al Ghazal Customer Satisfaction Center: You can find it at Al Ghazal and it offers all services regarding Emirates ID.

Al Yalayes Customer Satisfaction Center: Its location is in Dubai Investment Park. It offers only fingerprinting services for the application of the identification card.

Customer Satisfaction Center in Al Rashidiya: Its location is in the Al Rashidiya district, behind the Rashidiya City Hall. Like the previous center, it only offers fingerprinting services for the issuance of the Emirates ID.

Al Nahda Customer Satisfaction Center: You can find it attached to the Salem Medical Examination Center in Al Qusais, behind the Grand Car Wash station. They only offer fingerprinting services for the Emirates ID issuance application.

Frequently asked questions about Emirates ID verification

Even though the Emirates ID verification process is explained in detail, there are always doubts about it. For this reason, we answer the most frequent questions that people ask regarding this topic:

Is it possible to obtain or verify the Emirates ID without a visa? The answer is no. To obtain an Emirates ID in Dubai, it is necessary to have a resident visa beforehand. Similarly, if you do not have a valid visa you will not be able to verify your Emirates ID.

How long does it take to process the Emirates ID? Usually, the Emirates ID is issued within 7 to 10 days after the visa has been stamped in your passport. However, you will be able to review your application online and you will also receive updates via text message. A recommendation in the meantime is to register and access the electronic version.

How long does it take to get an Emirates ID after the medical examination? The result of your medical examination usually takes 1-2 days. Your Emirates ID will then be issued within 4 business days.

If I order a replacement Emirates ID card, how long does it take? After following all the steps to renew it, you will receive a text message from the ICA about the status of your application. Then, you will be able to pick it up within 48 hours or 24 hours if you paid an additional charge for the express service and get it earlier.

How long does the verification process take?

If you want to move to Dubai, it is important that you take into account the time the verification process takes. In addition, in the case of Emirates ID for UAE residents you must also take into account this processing time. Usually, the process starts when you have completed your medical aptitude test and have the results.

In this way, once the applicant completes his medical aptitude test, the results will be sent to the GDRFA in his emirate. Then, when all the paperwork has been approved, your residence visa will be issued. After all this process is finished, it is when your new Emirates ID begins to be printed.

The process that entire process of the residence visa and the Emirates ID is approved, and your Emirates ID will begin to be issued. The entire process usually takes up to a week and you will not be able to obtain your Emirates ID until your residence visa has been issued. Also, if you are new to the UAE, you must register all your biometrics that will be required for the issuance of your Emirates ID.

The processing time for issuing an Emirates ID ranges from 2 days to 2 weeks. At any time within this period, you will be able to obtain your Emirates ID. If you need to record your biometric data, it may take more days depending on when your data appointment is. You will be able to track your application online with the QR code you receive from the registration form.

What to do If there are errors in your Emirates ID?

It is important to understand that if there are errors in our Emirates ID it is not the end of the world. In this case, depending on the error, you should be able to easily fix it by following the appropriate prompts. One case where you may notice an error is when some of your data has changed for no reason. In this way, if this happens, you should immediately contact the ICA customer satisfaction centers.

It is important to note that this must be done within the first 30 days after you have made the change of information. For this process, you must have your original passport and your old Emirates ID. Please note that updating will not be possible your card information online so do not waste time on this. The process can be applied to all types of identification documents in the country.

Your Emirates ID has a lot of information related to your personal data apart from the 15-digit Emirates ID number. For this reason, they must not contain any errors, as this can cause the owner to have problems later. It is important that when you receive your Emirates ID you verify that all your personal details match correctly and there are no mismatches.

However, if at the time of verification, you notice an error, you must edit the incorrect data for the correct data. In this way, as in the previous case, you must go to a nearby ICA branch. This will allow you to change the key details of your Emirates ID, but if you want to change non-key details, you have other options. In this case, you can use the electronic services kiosk at an ICA branch or center.

Ensuring your Emirates ID is up to date: A quick check

It is important that you make sure that it is updated to avoid any future problems. To carry out this process you will have two options, one is through the ICA website and the other through a voice call.

Through the ICA page: Using the ICA website you will be able to obtain your answer. The steps to follow are simple and are similar to when you apply.

First step: Enter the ICA website and it will ask you in which language you want to browse the page. You can choose between Arabic or English.

Second step: On the page, you will see the main menu with different options. You will need to select the option where it says to verify your Emirates ID status.

Third step: If you carry out the process from the web page, the number will be sent by SMS. Also, the number is called PRAN, if you do not know where it is, you can search your application form and you will be able to find it.

Fourth step: After placing the PRAN an option will appear that says verify, click on it and you will be able to see the status of your Emirates ID.

Using a voice call: You can check the status by making a call by following these steps:

Step 1: Call the appropriate number and go through the verification process. They will ask you for the PRAN and what you want to know about your Emirates ID. They may also ask you for your valid passport number.

Step 2: After waiting a few seconds, the operator will tell you all the details of your request. You can take advantage of asking any questions you have at the moment. Also, if you apply for a renewal you can do that.

FAQs

What is the process for Emirates ID verification in the UAE?

It usually starts with submitting your Emirates ID details through an official portal or service provider. The information is then checked against government records to confirm your identity.

Which documents are required for Emirates ID verification?

You only need your Emirates ID. Sometimes, a passport copy or visa details may be requested for additional verification.

How long does Emirates ID verification take in 2026?

Verification can take anywhere from a few minutes to a few working days, depending on the platform and the accuracy of the details submitted.

Can I verify my Emirates ID online?

Yes. Emirates ID verification can be done online through approved government portals and authorized service providers.

What happens if my Emirates ID verification fails?

If verification fails, you may be asked to resubmit correct details or provide additional documents.
